records.title: Moc window lane dead -- non-damaging basic never consumes landedConsequences
records.counterexample: doc_chuong authors zero damage (PoisonPath sec.1) so it routes to the for_each_target lane; landedConsequences' sole consumer sat inside adaptDamageOp -- the van_moc->sinh_co plant never fired.
records.expected: spec D11/D15: Sinh Co marker plants on the first own-source landed Moc basic while van_moc is up.
records.fix: Non-damaging enemy-scope lane appends def.landedConsequences per loop target (landing = application); pin test in LegacySkillAdapter.test.ts.

records.title: Water empowered rider hardcodes han_tuc chance 0.5 (specialization authors 0.65/0.4)
records.counterexample: Secondary hit applies han_tuc at fixed 0.5 while the specialization-modified primary applies 0.65 (Ngung Lien) or 0.4 (Dao Lan).
records.expected: Reviewer expectation: rider mirrors the primary's effective chance.
records.rejectionReason: Spec D4 pins no chance for the secondary's ailment application -- the rider is a distinct authored op, and its 0.5 equals the BASE authored chance. Specialization parity would require a new resolve-time seam (writing the modified value into a static consequence table). Recorded as design observation; revisit if spec pins the rule.

records.title: saveVersion.ts header omits the v85 changelog entry
records.counterexample: CURRENT_SAVE_VERSION = 85 has no changelog line; a retire-heavy pass leaves no trail in the file.
records.fix: v85 changelog entry added (route slots / kiem_tu queue / the_tu_an ops pane retirements).

records.title: Bound marker pays one last periodic_growth tick after mid-action window loss
records.counterexample: runPeriodicPhase ticks BEFORE runPhaseB's bound re-sweep; a marker whose bound window expired mid-action still feeds one periodic_growth grant (and consumes) in the gap.
records.fix: applyPeriodicGrowth skips a marker whose boundToSourceBuffId source no longer holds the window (same liveness rule as the (5b) re-sweep).

records.title: Stale emitGrants doc comment claims follow-up executions mint The; engine-lane divergence is latent
records.counterexample: Doc said 'root plans AND follow-up executions' but subcastIndex>0 suppresses them. The engine lane (runtime===undefined) is NOT gated on executionCommitsCast -- latent divergence, reachable only in unit-test harnesses (production always mints a runtime).
records.fix: Comment corrected to root-plan-only semantics. Engine-lane divergence recorded as latent (no live consumer).

records.title: hitOpIdsByTarget accumulates secondary-hit ops -- future target_hit_landed gate could open on a secondary's landing
records.counterexample: Per-target map records every hit op aimed at the target including secondaries minted by other lanes; a lane whose primary whiffed could still see target_hit_landed true if an earlier lane's secondary landed on it.
records.rejectionReason: Latent today: the only authored consumer (water rider) sits inside the oncePerCast dedup wrapper, so the dedup suppresses it first; adversarial execution tests confirm no live leak. Recorded as a lesson -- if a future lane authors target_hit_landed without the flag, scope the map to lane-primary hits.

records.title: PHAP_TU_SPECIAL_COOLDOWN_TURNS(5) > PHAP_TRANG_TURNS(3) makes keep/refresh window semantics unreachable at authored numbers
records.counterexample: Window (3 turns) always expires before the special's cooldown (5 turns) permits recast; keep/refresh branch is dead at current authored numbers.
records.rejectionReason: Both numbers are spec-authored; the refresh path exists for retuning. No behavioral defect -- design observation only.
